description: pr-create uses --body (with $(cat file)), not the unsupported --body-file.
failure_mode: The Go binary `pr create` has no --body-file flag; using it aborts PR creation.
prompt: You are creating a PR with the Go binary and have the body in a temp file. Which flag do you pass the body with?

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:--body-file\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: recommending or invoking --body-file (the binary has no such flag); naming it to reject it is fine
